abstract: Testicular germ cell tumors (GCTs) commonly metastasize to the retroperitoneal lymph nodes (RPLNs). We evaluated 100 cases of RPLN dissection specimens with viable GCTs after chemotherapy and compared them with their corresponding orchiectomy specimens. The mean age of patients was 28 years (range, 15-58 years). The testicular tumors consisted of mixed GCT (n = 72), teratoma (n = 18), seminoma (n = 4), embryonal carcinoma (n = 3), yolk sac tumor (n = 1), and no viable tumor (n = 2). Somatic malignant components were found in 5 cases. The metastatic tumors in the RPLNs consisted of only teratoma (n = 77) and non-teratomatous GCT (n = 23). Twenty-one patients had only teratoma in the RPLNs but not in the testis, and 10 patients had metastatic non-teratomatous GCT components that were not observed in the testis. Six patients had somatic malignant components in the RPLNs, but only one of them had such a component in the testis. Overall, 13 patients died of disease in a mean of 42 months, and the patients with only teratoma in the RPLNs had a lower mortality rate (9%) than those with non-teratomatous components (26%) (P = .044). One patient with somatic components in the primary GCT and 3 patients with somatic components in the metastases died of disease. Our study demonstrates that there is frequent discordance of histologic composition between primary and metastatic testicular GCTs. Teratoma is the most common component in treated GCTs and is usually associated with a more favorable clinical outcome than non-teratomatous GCTs. The presence of somatic components in the RPLNs metastasis indicates a poor prognosis.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)は後腹膜リンパ節(RPLN)へ転移しやすい。化学療法後に生存腫瘍が残存したRPLN郭清標本100例を、対応する精巣摘除標本と比較して検討した。患者の平均年齢は28歳(範囲15〜58歳)であった。原発精巣腫瘍は、混合型GCT(72例)、奇形腫(18例)、セミノーマ(4例)、胎児性癌(3例)、卵黄嚢腫瘍(1例)、生存腫瘍なし(2例)であった。体細胞型悪性成分は5例に認められた。RPLN転移は奇形腫のみ(77例)と非奇形腫性GCT(23例)であった。RPLNにのみ奇形腫を認めた症例が21例、精巣には認めず非奇形腫性成分のみRPLNに認めた症例が10例あった。RPLNに体細胞型悪性成分を認めた6例のうち、精巣にも認めたのは1例のみであった。全体で13例が平均42か月で原病死した。RPLNが奇形腫のみの患者の死亡率(9%)は、非奇形腫性成分を有する患者(26%)より低かった(P=.044)。原発GCTに体細胞型成分を有する1例と、転移巣に体細胞型成分を有する3例が原病死した。原発と転移のGCTでは組織像の不一致が高頻度に存在することが示された。奇形腫は治療後GCTで最も多い成分であり、通常は非奇形腫性GCTより良好な臨床経過と関連する。RPLN転移に体細胞型成分が存在することは予後不良を示す。
